changelog:
- Initial release of the home-assistant-master skill.
- Added core safety-first, diagnostics-first operating policies for Home Assistant OS operations.
- Supports read-only audits, diagnostics, automation design/review, dashboard planning, integration risk assessment, and backup readiness.
- Explicitly blocks all writes, restarts, updates, or security-sensitive changes without user approval.
- Replaces documentation file (skill-card.md) with skill metadata (_meta.json).
summary: Home Assistant OS (HAOS) operations skill for OpenClaw agents. Use for read-only audits, diagnostics, automation design/review, dashboard UX planning, voice intent mapping, integration risk assessment, backup/restore readiness checks, and maintenance playbooks. Default to read-only; require explicit approval before any write/reload/restart. Apply when users ask to troubleshoot entities/devices/integrations, improve reliability, design automations, or plan safe Home Assistant changes.
